source.name: Capital Area Food Bank — Get Help map (partner sites)
known_limitations: county_name values are inconsistent ('VA Manassas City' vs 'VA City of Manassas'); jurisdiction is re-derived from coordinates.
Unused day slots repeat slot-1 times; only slots with a Frequency value are read.
Non-weekly frequencies other than ordinal weeks (e.g. 'Every other week') are kept as notes, not schedules.
No website field: official provider websites must be added by reviewers.
CAFB advises calling ahead to confirm hours.

note: Imported records are unverified candidates. Nothing in this run was published or marked verified.
